tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.dead: Bites the dead: a coated blade hits skeletons, zombies and the risen harder. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.beasts: Bites beasts: a coated blade hits wolves, bears and the like harder. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.brutes: Bites brutes: a coated blade hits ogres, trolls and their kin harder. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.people: Bites people: a coated blade hits raiders, bandits and other folk harder. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.cursed: Garlic and silver. Bites the cursed: a coated blade hits vampires and werewolves harder. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.poison: A coated blade poisons what it cuts. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.haze: A coated blade leaves what it cuts weak and dazed. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.mark: A coated blade leaves what it cuts glowing, so it can be tracked through walls. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.toxin: A coated blade loads what it cuts with a toxin that wastes it slowly. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.smoke: A coated blade blinds what it cuts, and leaves a puff of smoke. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.acid: A coated blade eats the armour of what it cuts. Thrown on ore, it dissolves the rock round it and leaves more ore. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.fire: A coated blade sets what it cuts alight. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.mending: Coat a tool: it mends a little with each block or blow. Use it with a blade in your other hand, or throw it with nothing there. Sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.fire_ward: Thrown at friends: keeps fire from them for a while. Use it to throw it, or sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil.healing: Thrown at friends: mends their wounds. Use it to throw it, or sneak-use it on the ground to spill a slick.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.fire_burst: A burst of fire that breaks wood, webs and nests. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.stun_flash: A blinding flash that stuns whatever is near. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.fire_spread: Sets the ground alight round where it lands. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.poison_cloud: A lingering cloud of poison. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.volatile_gas: A cloud of gas that explodes if flame reaches it. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.freeze_blast: A blast of cold that freezes what it hits and grounds the flying. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.snuffer: Silences magic where it lands: no teleporting, casting, beams or portals, and the powers of those in it go quiet for a while. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bomb.stopper_dust: A dust that stops regeneration, invisibility and turning for a while. Use it to throw it; a spent casing comes back for strong spirit to refill.
tooltip.jaymospowers.oil_sash.empty: Empty. Use it on a full oil pot to fill it; use it to throw a charge; sneak-use it to change pocket.
research.jaymospowers.hunters_oils.text: Grease rendered from a gutted monster's fat, a crucible and the right essences make the oils a hunter coats a blade with, or throws. Pour an oil into an oil pot to keep it, dip a blade in the pot, and fill a sash or bandolier from it.
